name.zh: 平行杆团身 L 撑

purpose.zh: 练腹部和髋屈肌，提升支撑力量
purpose.en: Build the abs and hip flexors and strengthen your support.

text.zh: 手臂锁直、肩下压，把膝盖抬到胸前
text.en: Lock your arms, press your shoulders down, and pull your knees to your chest

text.zh: 骨盆微微后倾，胸口保持挺直
text.en: Tilt your pelvis back slightly and keep your chest tall.

text.zh: 能力够了再一条腿伸直，逐步到 L 撑
text.en: When ready, straighten one leg, working toward a full L-sit.

commonErrors.en: Rounding the back and shrugging the shoulders.
Letting the knees drop to the floor.

cautions.zh: 先做手腕热身；手腕刺痛或发麻就停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists first, and stop if they feel sharp pain or numbness.
